cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:2d8.description: Position Overview As a Coffee Specialist at Seattle Coffee Gear, you are a customer-facing product expert responsible for delivering exceptional, consultative experiences on the sales floor. You bring Seattle Coffee Gear’s passion for great coffee to life through one-on-one customer interactions and live product demonstrations, helping customers understand brewing methods, espresso fundamentals, and coffee equipment in a practical, approachable way. In this role, you focus on engaging customers in real time, listening to their needs, demonstrating products, and translating technical features into clear benefits. You play a critical role in driving sales of espresso machines, grinders, coffee makers, and accessories by helping customers understand the why behind great coffee and confidently guiding them toward products that fit their goals, taste preferences, and lifestyle. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Seattle Coffee Gear’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Lead engaging and informative coffee brewing demonstrations that showcase our Seattle Coffee Gear’s expertise and unique competitive edge offerings. · Educate customers on a variety of brewing techniques, including pour-over, French Press, AeroPress, espresso, cold brew, and coffee art. · Guide customers in selecting coffee beans based on flavor profiles, roast levels, and origin. · Maintain a “coffee-ready” environment by ensuring quality and consistency across in-store brewing and demonstrations. Sales & Business Performance · Recommend appropriate coffee equipment and maintenance practices based on customer needs. · Promote and sell coffee products, equipment, and accessories through product demonstrations. · Assist the store in achieving revenue goals by driving customer engagement and conversion through education. · Consistently meet or exceed store goals by delivering exceptional customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by product sales performance through SPH, UPT & guest feedback. Team Engagement & Store Support · Partner with store leaders to ensure alignment with store priorities. · Collaborate on merchandising strategies that highlight key tools and products featured in classes. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Seattle Coffee Gear policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to grind, tamp, steam, pour, froth, and/or demonstrate other coffee brewing techniques. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. · Available to work between 12 and 16 hours per week, with a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. You will help coordinate onboarding, certifications, workshops, webinars, sales plays, and continuous learning initiatives. A key focus will be creating accessible learning resources, maintaining content ecosystems, and ensuring smooth virtual enablement experiences. jobgether-jobgether:lever:2d8ff7e6-2c20-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Pharmacy Technician, Prior Authorization based in the United States. This fully remote role supports medical management operations within a health plan focused on improving care for older adults. You’ll play an important role in reviewing and coordinating pharmacy prior authorization requests and supporting timely clinical decisions. The position combines pharmacy knowledge, provider communication, member support, and detailed administrative work. You’ll collaborate closely with pharmacists, physicians, providers, members, and clinical partners across multiple workflows. The environment is fast-paced and dynamic, requiring strong organization, adaptability, and attention to detail. Your work will directly contribute to accurate benefit administration and a smoother healthcare experience for members. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced pharmacy technician seeking meaningful, healthcare-focused work from home. Review and process prior authorization requests in accordance with established policies, procedures, and decision trees, ensuring accurate and timely handling. Triage and enter incoming authorization requests from provider offices and coordinate the information required for clinical review. Apply preferred product strategies and collaborate with providers to support appropriate utilization of Part B medication benefits. Communicate clinical decisions to provider groups and members while addressing questions and concerns regarding alternative treatment options. Provide operational support across medical management workflows, enabling pharmacists and physicians to make efficient, high-quality decisions. Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders and provide workflow support to clinical partners. Strong proficiency with technology and digital collaboration tools, including Gmail/G Suite and multiple software systems. Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when working with providers, members, partners, and internal teams. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly and unexpected issues require practical problem-solving. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e3683d96-76c4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Junior Accountant based in Canada. This is an opportunity for an early-career accounting professional to join a collaborative, technology-driven Finance team within a growing SaaS environment. You’ll support essential accounting operations across billing, accounts receivable, collections, reconciliations, and month-end close. The role combines hands-on financial responsibilities with opportunities to improve processes and introduce greater efficiency through technology and automation. You’ll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and other Finance stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain accurate financial records. The position is well suited to someone who is detail-oriented, curious, and eager to develop their accounting expertise. You’ll also gain exposure to AI-enabled tools and modern financial systems while contributing to a fast-moving, supportive team. Prepare and issue accurate customer invoices based on contracts, billing terms, and internal policies. Review customer, contract, and billing information to ensure records are complete, accurate, and up to date across financial systems. Manage accounts receivable activities and conduct timely, professional follow-ups on outstanding balances to support healthy cash flow. Respond to customer billing questions and work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to resolve discrepancies and payment issues. Provide backup support for vendor invoice and payment inquiries, including accounts payable activities when required. Assist with AR aging analysis, cash collection reporting, and other financial reports used by management. Support month-end close processes, including account reconciliations, revenue checks, and variance analysis. Identify opportunities to simplify accounting workflows, improve data accuracy, and reduce manual work. Support the implementation and adoption of financial automation and technology solutions that improve Finance team efficiency. Use internal procurement and financial technology in daily workflows while providing feedback that can inform future product and process improvements. Requirements: 1–2 years of experience in a similar Finance or accounting role, preferably within a SaaS or technology environment. Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, organization, and consistency when handling financial information. Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both internal teams and customers. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, particularly Excel or Google Sheets, and motivated to develop proficiency with accounting and CRM systems such as Sage Intacct and Salesforce. Proactive and accountable approach, with the ability to take ownership of responsibilities and reliably follow through. Curious mindset and willingness to understand how financial systems work and identify faster, more effective ways of completing tasks.
